On `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, Rust’s `HashMap` is **not randomized** as it is on other platforms. It uses a fixed or hard-coded seed, so its behavior is deterministic and the same execution produces the same hashing/iteration behavior. [Rust documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/platform-support/wasm32-unknown-unknown.html)

If randomized behavior is required, a JavaScript-backed randomness source such as `getrandom` with the appropriate wasm-bindgen/JavaScript support must be used separately.
